::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Major networking and infrastructure chip design centre. India teams design switch ASICs and storage controllers that power global data centre infrastructure.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Ethernet switch ASICs, broadband SoCs, Wi-Fi chipsets, enterprise storage/RAID controllers, and custom silicon for hyperscale data centres.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 4/5:** Networking switch ASICs, SerDes/HBM IP and custom AI silicon.
- **Strategic depth 4/5:** Bangalore Development Center hosts ASIC Product Division and Central Engineering IP roles; product ownership mostly US.
- **Design completeness 5/5:** Job postings show RTL, verification, emulation, memory circuit and DFT work for networking and ASICs.
- **India scale 4/5:** No company figure found; third-party aggregators show a few thousand across Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune.
